spec2def(bluetoothapis.dll bluetoothapis.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# bluetoothapis.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/bluetoothapis-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(bluetoothapis_shims OBJECT gatt.c main.c sdp.c)
target_link_libraries(bluetoothapis_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_canunload libsetupapi libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(bluetoothapis_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    target_compile_options(bluetoothapis_shims PRIVATE -Wno-old-style-declaration)
endif()
set_wine_module(bluetoothapis_shims)
add_cargo_module(bluetoothapis bluetoothapis-cargo bluetoothapis.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS bluetoothapis_shims psdk)
